attributes.name: Shrieking Plant
attributes.powers:
When you examine this card, succeed at a Stealth or Survival 9 check or the Shrieking Plant is undefeated.

If undefeated, examine the top 3 cards of your location deck and encounter the first monster you find. Then banish the Shrieking Plant.
